name: Hiiragi Seigo
source: The protagonist. He's on the student council for his high school but he finds work to be bothersome. Once Chinu orders the entire student council, including himself, to stop wearing underwear there's opportunities to peek under the skirts of the girls and get a glimpse of nothing at all!
